The '''"24-karat" beaches''' were located on the [[Gold Beaches/Legends|Gold Beaches]], which stretched along the western coastline of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] southern [[Corellia's southern continent|continent]]. The Gold Beaches were considered to be among the most breathtaking natural wonders in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] for their stunning [[Beach/Legends|sands]] that glittered like [[Gold/Legends|gold]] in the light of [[Corell/Legends|Corell]], Corellia's [[Star/Legends|sun]].<ref name="Suns" />

The composition of the powdery sands included fossilized [[Algae/Legends|algae]], shells of [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Species/Legends|creatures]] and microscopic organisms, and concentrated [[Silica/Legends|silica]] from [[Coral/Legends|coral]] reefs. The "24-karat" beaches were located in the southerly portions of the Gold Beaches, and were known for their purer [[Color/Legends|color]] and texture. As such, they were the most popular tourist destination on the Gold Beaches and were featured heavily in advertisements.<ref name="Suns" />

==Behind the scenes==
The "24-karat" beaches were mentioned in ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'', a<ref name="Suns" /> [[2014]]<ref name="Sights">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2014/1/24/set-your-sights-on-corellia|text=Set Your Sights on Corellia|date=2014-01-24}}</ref> sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[roleplaying game]] by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="Suns" />
